properties.name: Northwest Territories and Yukon south of 63°N, west of 110°W
properties.source: The band between 58°N and the 63rd parallel north, from the Yukon's western edge east to 110°W (the Alberta–Saskatchewan border, carried straight up to 63°N, per the owner); it only cuts the territories' own land (their southern border is the 60th parallel). The territories east of 110°W are in no shetach and left off the map.
